entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I have an order, a jersey I think, and I'm just not sure what to do. The website is a bit confusing.
I can certainly help you with that. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
Oh, um, preference, I guess? It's just the wrong size. I tried it on and it's way too tight. I don't know if I can return it or if I need an exchange or... I'm just lost. Can't you just help me?
Of course. I understand it can be confusing sometimes. It sounds like you need to exchange it for a different size. I just need to pull up your order information. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, I think so. It's VF886-012.
Thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered on January 9th. That was 13 days ago. Just to confirm, there are no rips or defects, the jersey is just too tight, correct?
Correct. It's brand new, I only tried it on once. I just need a different size.
No problem at all. I've checked our policy, and you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window. We can absolutely get this processed for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can do an exchange?

Yes. The easiest way is to process this as a return for a full refund, and then you can place a new order for the correct size right away. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just print it out, attach it to the package, and drop it off.
Okay, that sounds simple enough. Thank you so much, Alex. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
